decisions.decision: Approved design knowledge used by a design is pinned in CIR provenance as {rule_id, rule_version, rule_digest, evaluation_digest}. Codex provides the approved-only reader and a verify_pins(db, pins) function that revalidates pins against the durable approved store (never activates an unapproved, revoked or unevaluated rule). Secondary's A6 carries the pin record in CIR provenance and calls verify_pins in certificate, release and quality paths. The PDF writer renders deterministically from the pinned closed-vocabulary record and REFUSES (fails closed) a CIR that carries a pin which is missing from the store or unverified; CIRs with no pins are unaffected. Any CIR shape change bumps core.contracts 'cir' (v3) in the same commit with the pin tests. Deployed images lacking research/bench2 report benchmark evaluation UNKNOWN; raw reference-derived research material is never shipped in the image.

There is no canonical consent or revocation record for customer support content. Absent consent is NOT permission: private support case text never feeds Learning (lessons, LearnGap evidence, design knowledge). Allowed: aggregate, non-identifying defect counts per release row (as used by P0-SUPPORT-DEFECT-INCIDENT for Product Truth withholding and re-verification), which carry no customer text. Any future use of support text needs an owner-approved consent policy, a consent field at SupportCase intake, and a revocation path that retracts derived evidence; until then Codex and Secondary do not wire support text into Learning.
